items.title: Solana ETFs extend growth streak to 5 days after year's biggest inflows
items.summary: Monday's $33.5 million was the largest single-day inflow since December, pushing cumulative net inflows to a record $1.22 billion and trading volume to $166.8 million.

items.title: Thailand moves closer to Bitcoin, Ether ETFs with draft rules
items.summary: Thailand’s SEC opened consultations on local Bitcoin and Ether ETF rules and qualification standards for foreign digital asset custodians.

items.title: Bitcoin ETFs add $338M as six-day inflow streak hits $2.26B
items.summary: Bitcoin ETFs have drawn $2.26 billion over six trading days, while year-to-date net outflows have narrowed to about $2.57 billion.
